The season began on 20 February and is scheduled to end on 13 December 2026.{{cite web |url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ecuador/liga-pro/minimos-cambios-oficial-nuevo-formato-torneo-ligapro-2026_0_WtQg1YRueS.html |title=Con mínimos cambios: se hizo oficial el nuevo formato de torneo para la LigaPro 2026 |trans-title=With minimal changes: the new tournament format for the 2026 LigaPro was made official |publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]] |language=es |date=15 December 2025 |access-date=15 December 2025}}{{cite web |last=Palacios |first=Juan José |url=https://studiofutbol.com.ec/2025/12/21/el-calendario-oficial-las-fechas-de-inicio-y-finalizacion-de-la-ligapro-2026/ |title=EL CALENDARIO OFICIAL: Las fechas de inicio y finalización de la LigaPro 2026 |trans-title=The official schedule: The 2026 LigaPro's start and end dates |publisher=Studio Fútbol |language=es |date=21 December 2025 |access-date=21 December 2025}} [[Independiente del Valle]] are the defending champions. ==Format changes== The format for the 2026 season was approved by the Council of Presidents of LigaPro on 15 December 2025. The tournament retained its two-stage setup, but with minor changes to the final stages: in the first stage the 16 participating teams played each other twice (once at home and once away) for a total of 30 matches, and teams were sorted according to their placement into two hexagonals and one quadrangular group for the final stages. The top six teams play the first hexagonal in which they will play each other twice to decide the season champions as well as three [[Copa Libertadores]] berths and three [[Copa Sudamericana]] ones, while the group in which the last berth to the Copa Sudamericana will be decided was downsized from six to four teams, those being the ones placing from seventh to tenth place in the first stage. The bottom six teams play a hexagonal to decide the two teams that will be relegated to [[Ecuadorian Serie B|Serie B]] at the end of the season. Although points from the first stage were still carried over to the final stage, this time the top team at the end of the first stage was not assured of qualification for the Copa Libertadores group stage. ==Teams== ===Team changes=== Sixteen teams compete in the season, the top 14 teams from the [[2025 LigaPro Serie A]] and the top two teams of the [[2025 Ecuadorian Serie B]]. [[C.D. Técnico Universitario|Técnico Universitario]] and [[Vinotinto F.C. Ecuador|Vinotinto Ecuador]] were relegated from Serie A after finishing in the bottom two places of the relegation group of the previous season,{{cite web|url=https://espndeportes.espn.com/futbol/ecuador/nota/_/id/16023488/tecnico-universitario-acompanara-a-vinotinto-para-jugar-la-liga-ecuabet-serie-b|title=El otro descendido: Técnico Universitario acompañará a Vinotinto para jugar la Liga Ecuabet Serie B|trans-title=The other relegated team: Técnico Universitario will join Vinotinto to play the Liga Ecuabet Serie B|publisher=[[ESPN Deportes]]|language=es|date=29 November 2025|accessdate=5 December 2025}} and were replaced by the second tier champions [[Guayaquil City F.C.|Guayaquil City]] and runners-up [[Leones F.C. (Ecuador)|Leones]]. Guayaquil City returned to the Serie A after two seasons with three matches to go after a 3–1 win over San Antonio on 12 October 2025,{{cite web|url=https://www.primicias.ec/deportes/guayaquil-city-ascenso-seriea-ligapro-chacaritas-descenso-segunda-107104/|title=Guayaquil City regresa a la Serie A y Chacaritas desciende a Segunda categoría: Así va la Serie B|trans-title=Guayaquil City return to the Serie A and Chacaritas are relegated to the Segunda Categoría: this is how the Serie B is going|publisher=Primicias|language=es|date=12 October 2025|accessdate=5 December 2025}} whilst Leones clinched a first-ever promotion to the top flight with one match left on 24 October, after Gualaceo was deducted nine points due to match-fixing.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com.ec/futbol/ecuador/nota/_/id/15861811/leones-del-norte-concreto-el-ascenso-y-jugara-la-liga-ecuabet-serie-a|title=Histórico: Leones del Norte concretó el ascenso y jugará la Liga Ecuabet Serie A|trans-title=Historic: Leones del Norte achieved promotion and will play the Liga Ecuabet Serie A|publisher=[[ESPN (Latin America)|ESPN]]|language=es|date=24 October 2025|accessdate=11 November 2025}} Although [[C.D. El Nacional|El Nacional]] avoided relegation on sporting merit, they were administratively relegated to Serie B on 16 December 2025 after defaulting on payments to their creditors on three occasions.{{cite news|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ecuador/liga-pro/crisis-nacional-descenso-confirmado-renuncia-marco-pazos_0_nuLOHnawHC.html |title=La crisis de El Nacional: se confirmó el descenso a la Serie B y renunció Marco Pazos |trans-title=El Nacional's crisis: relegation to Serie B was confirmed and Marco Pazos resigned |publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]] |language=es |date=16 December 2025 |access-date=17 December 2025}} The decision caused the club to place last in the 2025 season, thus sparing Técnico Universitario from relegation, which was ultimately confirmed on 9 January 2026.{{cite news|url=https://www.primicias.ec/deportes/ligapro/nacional/descenso-serieb-sancion-fef-110761/ |title=Oficial: El Nacional desciende y jugará en la Serie B en 2026 |trans-title=Official: El Nacional are relegated and will play in Serie B in 2026 |publisher=Primicias |language=es |date=10 December 2025 |access-date=10 December 2025}}{{cite news|last=Guillén |first=Adrián |url=https://studiofutbol.com.ec/2026/01/09/es-oficial-tecnico-universitario-se-queda-en-la-serie-a/ |title=ES OFICIAL: Técnico Universitario se queda en la Serie A |trans-title=IT'S OFFICIAL: Técnico Universitario stay in Serie A |publisher=Studio Fútbol |language=es |date=9 January 2026 |access-date=9 January 2026}} ===Stadia and locations=== {{location map+ |Ecuador |float=right |width=425 |caption=Locations of the 2026 Serie A clubs. |places= {{location map~ |Ecuador |lat=-0.278724 |long=-78.546433 |label=
